parsed_blocks.text: Dani needs a warm jacket for the winter. On Saturday he goes to a shop in the city centre.
He finds a blue jacket near the door. The label says medium. He takes it to the fitting room and tries it on.
The jacket is too small. The sleeves are too short and the shoulders are not wide enough. Dani asks an assistant for a bigger size.
The assistant brings a large one. This jacket fits well. Dani moves his arms and looks in the mirror.
He pays forty euros at the checkout. The assistant puts the jacket in a bag and gives him a small piece of paper. It is the receipt, and she tells him to keep it.
Two days later Dani looks at the blue jacket again. He does not like the colour now. He goes back to the same shop.
He shows the paper at the desk. The assistant tells him he has two choices. He can exchange the jacket for a grey one, or he can ask for a refund and take his money back.
Dani chooses the grey jacket in the same large size. He puts the new paper in his pocket and walks home.

data.example: The medium jacket is small on Dani, so he asks for a bigger one.

data.definition: money that a shop gives back to you when you return something
data.example: He can ask for a refund and take his money back.

data.definition: to give something back to a shop and take a different thing instead
